definitions.full: H5442. sebak סְבַךְ noun [masculine] thicket ; — absolute בַּסְּבַךְ ( נֶאֱחַז ) Gen 22:13 (so Ginsb; Baer בַּסֲבַךְ , van d. H. כַּסְּבָךְ ) a ram caught in the thicket by its horns; plural construct הַיַּעַר ִסבְכֵי Isa 9:17 thickets of the forest , 10:34 .
